verdict.rationale: The only deletion-related evidence is record-level Delete operations in the V3 API SDK and the official MCP server (full CRUD across 29 entity types), plus write/update toggles for scoping agents. Backup and restore exists in Advanced, but that is for undoing mistakes, not for managing retention. Missing for 10: configurable data-retention policies, account/company data deletion or erasure controls, controls over how long Intuit Intelligence/AI features retain user data, and privacy documentation or independent corroboration of deletion behavior.
